Build accessible responsive Svelte UI with correct landmarks/headings, labels/descriptions, table/list semantics, keyboard-only filter/autocomplete/results/detail operation, focus after search/modal/actions, live announcements, reduced-motion support and no horizontal overflow at accepted viewports. Add repository contracts preventing direct fetch/localStorage use outside governed services, unsafe id64 numeric coercion, client capture of backend routes, duplicate session/watchlist stores, secret persistence/logging and Finder/Inspect writes into canonical planner state.
